nodes.label: Consumer Goods Hero Image
nodes.visual_description: Colourful polymer pellets (red, blue, yellow, green, teal) forming and scattering from a consumer product shape (vacuum-like device) against a white background. Concept: masterbatch colour applied to plastic consumer products.

nodes.label: Packaging Industry Hero Image — PET Bottle
nodes.visual_description: Black-and-white dramatic photo of a clear PET bottle (labelled 'Pristine Packaging Sol 500ml PET') filled with and surrounded by clear polymer/resin pellets. Concept: raw polymer pellets forming finished packaging.

nodes.label: Packaging Industry Macro Hero — Coloured Film Sheets
nodes.visual_description: Close-up macro of overlapping translucent coloured plastic film or sheet layers in purple, blue, green, amber, and clear tones arranged in an abstract sculptural composition on a white background. Concept: colour masterbatch in flexible film packaging.

nodes.label: Pipes & Fittings Hero Image
nodes.visual_description: Monochrome 3D-render concept of a pipe or tube constructed from grey polymer pellets, with pellets dispersing explosively from the open end against a white background. Concept: masterbatch compounds forming extruded pipes.

nodes.label: Textiles & Fibres Hero Image
nodes.visual_description: Colourful polymer pellets in rainbow hues (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, white) being spun into a multicolour thread spool on a chrome metal bobbin and machine. Concept: colour masterbatch applied in synthetic fibre and textile extrusion.

nodes.label: Wire & Cable Industry Hero Image
nodes.visual_description: Real-world photograph of heavy-duty copper electrical cables (H1ZZZ2-K HV 240mm², Electra Core brand) with colour-coded insulation tips (red, blue, yellow) resting on a grey surface against a white background. Concept: PVC/XLPE insulation colour coding using masterbatch.

nodes.label: Agriculture Industry Card Image
nodes.visual_description: Ground-level close-up of a strawberry seedling emerging through an agricultural plastic mulch film with water droplets on the film surface; greenhouse structure visible in the bokeh background. Concept: agricultural plastic films and mulch using masterbatch additives.

nodes.label: Automotive Industry Card Image
nodes.visual_description: Close-up of a luxury car interior dashboard showing navy blue stitched leather trim, black textured plastic panels, chrome control knob and buttons (AUTO, DUAL mode). Concept: colour and additive masterbatch used in automotive interior plastic components.

nodes.label: Construction Industry Card Image
nodes.visual_description: Macro close-up of black textured rubber or polymer construction membrane (dimple drainage board / waterproofing membrane) with a ribbed flat sheet alongside it, set in an industrial environment. Concept: black or carbon masterbatch in construction polymer membranes and geomembranes.

nodes.label: Consumer Goods Industry Card Image — Household Products
nodes.visual_description: Styled product photograph of blue-toned household appliances and consumer electronics on a white table with an orange accent chair: electric kettle, toaster, utensil holder (all blue), white smart speaker, and teal Bluetooth headphones. Concept: colour masterbatch giving consistent, appealing colour to plastic consumer goods.

edges.note: Both images represent the Consumer Goods industry — hero (pellets forming product) and card (styled household goods). Different UI contexts for the same sector.
Both images represent the Packaging industry — rigid PET bottle hero and flexible film macro hero.
Both use the same visual concept of polymer pellets assembling into/out of a finished plastic product form.
Both use monochrome palette and the concept of pellets forming an extruded plastic product (pipe vs bottle).
Both hero images show colourful polymer pellets transforming into an end product, sharing the same visual language of masterbatch in action.
Both represent extruded polymer applications in infrastructure — pipes and cable insulation — sharing industrial, monochrome-leaning aesthetics.
Both wire & cable and construction are industrial polymer end-use sectors; cables are used within construction.
Both images feature thin plastic film/sheet applications — agricultural mulch film and packaging film — key masterbatch application areas.
Both card images show colour-critical plastic components in finished consumer/durable products — automotive interiors and household appliances.
Both construction and pipes sectors use polymer extrusion with masterbatch; pipes are a key construction material.
Agricultural mulch films and packaging share the flexible plastic film substrate; masterbatch additive and UV-stabiliser masterbatches serve both sectors.
Both textiles and wire/cable involve continuous polymer extrusion processes (fibre spinning vs cable sheathing) coloured by masterbatch.
